# that fails the gate is not left untouched: it still falls through to the
# ordinary Cardinal reading of each digit run, same as any unclaimed digits.
# negative: numerator not smaller than denominator — falls through to two
# denominators 13–99 derive the noun from the cardinal: -tel below 20, -stel from 20
# negative: a denominator above 99 that the table does not name falls through
# negative: preceded by a currency symbol with no space — not a fraction
# shape; the glued symbol is Money (`€1` → "ein Euro"), the rest falls through
# negative: date-like shape (adjacent digit-slash groups); the individual
# numbers still read through Cardinal and Year
# negative: "/" with no digits on either side is untouched — unrelated
# known limitation: no adjective agreement before a noun (design §14)
